name: docs_libraries
description:
List indexed libraries, exact versions and project environments (libraries, librerías, versión, entornos)

What Babel has indexed (exact versions), the registered environments (project
interpreters / node_modules folders; default_for says which one answers Python or
TypeScript when env is omitted) and recent background jobs. Use it to find an env id, or to follow a docset install / dependency
indexing job. Installed packages that are not listed yet are indexed automatically
the first time api_lookup or api_check_code needs them.

Args:
    ecosystem: "python", "js", "docset" or "markdown".
    env: environment id or project path; limits libraries to that environment.
    limit: libraries per page (default 15, max 200). offset: for the next page.

Returns: {libraries: [{id, ecosystem, name, version, env, status, entries}], total,
    has_more, next_offset, environments: [{id, label, python, default, ...}],
    jobs: [{id, kind, status, progress, message}]}.
Keywords: list libraries, what is installed, which version, environments, job progress,
    listar librerias, que hay instalado, que version tengo, entornos, progreso

name: docs_search
description:
Search installed APIs and docs by words (search docs, buscar función, cómo se hace, documentación)

Ranked full-text search over indexed APIs, offline docsets and markdown docs.
Use it when you know roughly what you need but not the exact name ("read a csv",
"retry on timeout"); then call api_lookup on the qualname you pick, or docs_read on a
section id. Only searches what is already indexed.

Args:
    query: words or an identifier; camelCase/snake_case/dotted names match by parts.
    library: one library name, e.g. "pandas" or a docset name.
    ecosystem: "python", "js", "docset" or "markdown".
    kind: "module", "class", "function", "method", "attribute", "property" or "section".
    env: environment id or project path.
    limit: default 8, max 50.

Returns: {results: [{id, qualname, kind, library, signature, summary, score}], count,
    truncated, did_you_mean?}. Signatures and summaries are cut at 200 characters.
Keywords: search docs, find function, how do I, which function, buscar documentacion,
    como se hace, que funcion, encontrar funcion

name: api_lookup
description:
Exact signature of an installed API (signature, firma, parámetros, documentación, versión instalada)

Parameters (with defaults and which are required), return type, docstring and
source location of one dotted symbol, from the version installed in the
environment - e.g. "pandas.DataFrame.merge", "httpx.Client", "json.dumps", or
"react.useState" for a node_modules package. Use it before calling any API you are not
sure about. Indexes the package on first use (local, no network; can take seconds).

Args:
    symbol: fully dotted path starting with the import name.
    env: environment id, project folder path, or omitted for the default environment.
    library: optional library name to disambiguate.

Returns: found=true -> {id, qualname, kind, signature, params: [{name, kind, annotation,
    default, required, description}], returns, summary, doc (first 1500 chars),
    doc_truncated, members (for modules/classes), library, source}. Use docs_read(id)
    for the rest of a long doc. found=false -> {certain, suggestions: [real names],
    message}; certain=false means the name may still exist at runtime.
Keywords: signature, parameters, arguments, api lookup, what does it take, return type,
    firma, parametros, argumentos, que recibe, que devuelve, existe esta funcion

name: api_check_code
description:
Check code for hallucinated or misused APIs of installed versions (check code, comprobar código, validar)

Statically checks a snippet against the libraries installed in the environment:
unknown modules/attributes (hallucinated or removed APIs), unexpected keyword arguments,
too many positional arguments, missing required arguments, deprecated calls. Never runs
the code. Run it on code you wrote before showing it; fix errors, re-check.

Args:
    code: the source (a whole file or a snippet; imports must be included).
    env: environment id, project folder path, or omitted for the default environment.
    language: "python" (full checks) or "typescript" (v1: named imports only).

Returns: {ok, findings: [{line, col, severity, code, symbol, message, suggestion}],
    checked, unchecked, libraries}. ok is false only for errors. severity "warning" =
    not a declared member but the class/module creates names dynamically, or deprecated.
    Babel stays silent on anything it cannot prove (dynamic code, unknown types,
    try/except ImportError, hasattr guards); those count in 'unchecked'.
Keywords: check code, validate code, hallucinated api, does this exist, wrong arguments,
    verify snippet, comprobar codigo, revisar codigo, validar, existe, alucinacion

name: docs_read
description:
Read the full text of one doc entry by id, in chunks (read docs, leer documentación, seguir leyendo)

One entry is a docset page section, a markdown section or a long docstring. Ids come from docs_search results and from
api_lookup (field id).

Args:
    id: the entry id, passed back exactly.
    offset: character offset to continue from (use next_offset).
    max_chars: chunk size, default 4000, max 20000.

Returns: {found, qualname, library, text, offset, total_chars, has_more, next_offset}.
Keywords: read doc, full documentation, read more, continue, leer documentacion,
    seguir leyendo, documentacion completa

name: docs_add_environment
description:
Register a project folder or venv so its packages can be checked (register project, registrar proyecto)

Accepts a project folder (its .venv/venv/env and node_modules, also in frontend/,
web/, client/ or ui/, are detected), a python/python.exe interpreter, or a
node_modules folder. The most recently registered project becomes the default env
(per language: Python checks never default to a node_modules-only env). Registering
again is harmless and makes it the default again.

Args:
    path: absolute path to the project folder, interpreter or node_modules.
    index_dependencies: also index the project's direct dependencies (from
        pyproject.toml / requirements*.txt) in a background job.

Returns: {environment: {id, label, python, ...}, dependency_job_id, dependencies, message}.
Keywords: register project, add environment, use this project, index project,
    registrar proyecto, anadir entorno, indexar proyecto, usar este proyecto

name: docs_catalog

Returns: {results: [{slug, name, version, db_size_kb}], count, total, truncated}.
Keywords: docset catalogue, offline docs, available documentation, download docs,

name: docs_install_docset
description:
Download and index one offline docset in background (install docs, instalar documentación, descargar)

Takes a slug from docs_catalog (e.g. "python~3.13"). Reaches the internet. Runs as a background job and returns at once;
follow it with docs_libraries (jobs) and search it with docs_search when done.

Args:
    slug: the exact slug from docs_catalog.

Returns: {job_id, status, slug, message}.
Keywords: install docset, download documentation, offline docs, instalar documentacion,
    descargar documentacion

name: docs_index_folder
description:
Index a folder of Markdown docs for search (index folder, indexar carpeta, documentación del proyecto)

Indexes .md/.mdx/.rst/.txt files (a project's docs/ folder, a cloned docs

Dependency, VCS and build folders are skipped; at most 2000 files.

Args:

Returns: {id, name, status, entry_count, note, hint}.
Keywords: index folder, index markdown, project docs, indexar carpeta,
    indexar documentacion, documentacion del proyecto

name: docs_check_locales
description:
Check JSON locale keys and placeholders (comprobar traducciones, translation audit)

Reads `<locale>.json` files in one directory. Nested objects become dotted keys.
Compares each target locale against source_locale; complex ICU-style messages
are counted as unchecked rather than claimed valid. Never edits a catalogue.

Args:
    path: absolute path to the directory containing en.json, es.json, etc.
    source_locale: source file stem, default en.
    offset: finding offset for the next page.
    limit: findings per page, at most 100.

Returns: {source_locale, locales, source_keys, total, unchecked_messages,
    findings: [{locale, key, kind, expected?, actual?}], truncated,
    has_more, next_offset}.
Keywords: translation audit, localization keys, placeholder mismatch, i18n,
    comprobar traducciones, claves faltantes, variables de traducción, idiomas

name: theseus_runtime_start
description: Run an explicitly selected Android, instrumentation, V8 Inspector or browser CDP operation in a project. ADB requires an exact serial; Frida requires a selected device, PID/argv or live project session; Inspector requires an explicit endpoint and exact target ID. Inspector/CDP metadata never evaluates, pauses or closes the target; script text, page DOM/listeners, completed response bodies and PNG are explicit choices. Device actions and instrumentation scripts can change their targets. Captures are historical, not behavioral equivalence; cancellation cannot undo effects. Remote tokens are ephemeral and excluded from recordings.

description: Edit a project question/name or archive and restore it.

name: theseus_artifact_add
description: Inspect a local file or directory without executing it: Python, JS, HAR, source maps, ZIP, ASAR, PE and SQLite. Artefacto, binario, imports, funciones.

name: theseus_artifact_read
description: Read the mechanical inspection and its recorded content hash.

name: theseus_artifact_excerpt
description: Read bytes or an archive member at a cited location; reports whether source changed.

name: theseus_artifact_image
description: Read a registered PNG with its exact recorded SHA-256; MCP returns native image content and identity metadata. No target or URL is accessed.

name: theseus_finding_add
description: Save an observed fact at an artifact location; interpretation is separate. Pass source_sha256 from a newer excerpt/analysis when citing that version; source_refs preserves all artifact identities in a comparison. Evidencia y observacion.

name: theseus_specification_write
description: Save the editable behavior specification, citing finding IDs and separating unknowns.

name: theseus_scenario_save
description: Save explicit command arrays/shared input or hash-bound retained browser.scenario captures. Retained cases compare complete, literally aligned step responses without connecting or replaying. Escenario diferencial.

name: theseus_comparison_start
description: Run saved scenarios as a recoverable background comparison. Returns a job ID; read it until finished. Compara original y reconstruccion.

name: theseus_job_read
description: Read background analysis/comparison progress, retained sources, frozen inputs, program hashes and diagnostics.

name: theseus_job_cancel
description: Stop owned host clients of an active analysis or comparison. Completed observations can remain; cancellation does not undo target-side effects.

name: theseus_project_export
description: Export a project JSON record with evidence and reproducible comparison receipts. Artifact paths reference originals.

name: theseus_local_engines
description: Discover installed local free binary analysis engines and JDK. No hosted service.

name: theseus_binary_analysis
description: Analyze a local binary with installed Ghidra: retained native project, functions, pseudocode and call edges. Does not execute the binary. Returns a job ID for theseus_job_read. Descompilar, desensamblar, funciones.

name: theseus_function_read
description: Read one decompiled function with its callees, callers, address and artifact hash, without loading the entire analysis into context.

name: theseus_analysis_catalog
description: Discover native local analysis operations, parameter schemas and installed engine availability.

name: theseus_analysis_start
description: Start a native static analysis of a project artifact. Discover the operation and parameters through theseus_analysis_catalog. Returns a persistent job; never executes target code.

name: theseus_analysis_records
description: Search and page retained analysis records by section and name, without loading the complete document. Omit limit for the default page; null returns all headers.

name: theseus_analysis_record
description: Read one complete retained analysis record with its source artifact hash, including CIL instructions and physical byte offsets.

name: theseus_binary_catalog
description: Discover the native binary session operations and default parameter objects. The incorporated engine supports Ghidra assembly, types, xrefs, memory, high-p-code and retained annotations.

name: theseus_binary_sessions
description: List persistent native binary sessions in a project and their actual connection state.

name: theseus_binary_open
description: Open a native local binary session. options may select analysis_job_id to reopen a retained project; language_id/compiler_spec_id; or raw=true with explicit language_id/base_address. Returns a background job/session ID. Does not execute target code.

name: theseus_binary_call
description: Run a discovered native engine operation in an open session. Returns a persistent job; read theseus_job_read and its analysis record sections. Annotations change only the saved analysis database, preserving source bytes.

name: theseus_binary_close
description: Close a native binary session and save its retained analysis project. Returns a background close job.

name: theseus_binary_compare
description: Compare selected functions from two open native sessions, including exact referenced data bytes. Normalize only proven decoder address fields; unresolved boundaries remain unknown. Returns a persistent job, not a behavioral equivalence proof.

name: theseus_workflow_read
description: Read reconstruction obligations, unresolved questions, evidence freshness, behavior handoffs and oracle sensitivity results. Completion is derived from observations, not an editable pass flag.

name: theseus_claim_save
description: Create or revise a behavior obligation or unknown with finding/scenario dependencies and owner. Unknown resolution keeps evidence links. Obligaciones y preguntas abiertas.

name: theseus_handoff_create
description: Freeze the current behavior specification and claims for a builder workspace. Reader findings and original paths remain separate from the builder document. Does not generate or copy source code.

name: theseus_handoff_read
description: Read a saved immutable handoff; builder_only returns only the behavior document, without reader findings/artifact paths.

name: theseus_oracle_selftest
description: Test deliberately wrong command candidates or explicitly mapped retained page captures, one capture per selected scenario. Reports detected, surviving and invalid observations. Retained tests never connect or replay; incomplete, changed or unaligned captures cannot certify sensitivity.

name: theseus_reconstruction_verify
description: Run saved differential scenarios linked to an immutable behavior handoff. Each retry preserves the original handoff identity and complete observations; a newer specification is explicitly reported.

name: theseus_evidence_export
description: Export portable historical findings, scenarios, receipts, workflow, full analysis records and retained JSON documents with SHA-256 integrity. Original files, native Ghidra projects and live sessions are excluded.

name: theseus_evidence_import
description: Validate an evidence bundle and import it as a NEW project with remapped identities. Imported receipts remain historical, never count as current verification, and no saved command or engine is started. Original paths remain references.
